facts.label: Treatment delivery
facts.quote: participants took either caffeine (150 mg) or placebo (mannitol) in identical appearing gelatin capsules (Hänseler AG, Herisau, Switzerland)

facts.label: Forbidden substances
facts.value: caffeinated beverages and food (e.g. coffee, tea, soda drinks, and chocolate), alcohol, nicotine, and medications
facts.quote: Furthermore, volunteers were requested to refrain from caffeinated beverages and food (e.g. coffee, tea, soda drinks, and chocolate), alcohol, nicotine, and medications.

facts.label: Light conditions
facts.value: dim-light (< 8 lx) during scheduled wakefulness and 0 lx during sleep
facts.quote: volunteers were housed in single apartments under dim-light (< 8 lx) during scheduled wakefulness and 0 lx during sleep.

facts.label: Posture requirement
facts.value: semi-recumbent position during wakefulness, except for restroom breaks
facts.quote: Volunteers were asked to maintain a semi-recumbent position during wakefulness, except for restroom breaks.

facts.label: Meal standardization
facts.quote: In addition, volunteers received standardized meals in regular intervals.

facts.label: Social and time cues
facts.value: Social interactions were restricted to team members and no time-of-day cues were provided
facts.quote: Social interactions were restricted to team members and no time-of-day cues were provided throughout the in-lab protocol.

facts.label: Condition order allocation
facts.quote: Volunteers were allocated to the order of the three conditions based on pseudo-randomization, for more details see Weibel et al..

facts.label: Excluded sleep nights
facts.value: Ten nights were excluded from sleep analyses due to technical problems (placebo:= 3; caffeine:= 4; withdrawal:= 3)
facts.quote: Ten nights were excluded from sleep analyses due to technical problems (placebo:= 3; caffeine:= 4; withdrawal:= 3).

facts.label: Excluded non-compliant dataset
facts.value: One dataset has been excluded from all the analyses due to non-compliance with the treatment requirements
facts.quote: One dataset has been excluded from all the analyses due to non-compliance with the treatment requirements (caffeine:= 1).

facts.label: Prior evidence species
facts.quote: However, during conditions of chronic caffeine intake, mice showed a deeper sleep compared to placebo.
